text: What a magical, awe-inspiring show! It’s really a story about lost love: the protagonist finds love right at the beginning, then abruptly loses it, and from there the plot twists in ways I didn’t expect. The lighting, recurring water imagery, music, and visual design all work together beautifully, creating some genuinely breathtaking moments. Actors and dancers share the stage with synchronized swimmers and acrobats, and every performance feels incredibly precise. There are wild flips, dramatic dives into the water, and synchronized routines where the swimmers repeatedly hold their breath for many seconds. Somehow it balances the emotional drama with some genuinely funny moments too. I was completely swept up, and the whole production feels imaginative, grand, and surprisingly moving. If you get the chance, go for it. It’s truly an absolute must-see.
